top_stories.title: Hackers exploit trusted AWS access to breach multiple cloud environments
top_stories.summary: A threat actor compromised IAM credentials associated with a Qubole big data platform AWS account to breach multiple customers' cloud environments and exfiltrate data. The attack exploited trusted AWS IAM access, demonstrating how compromised third-party IAM credentials can cascade into multi-tenant cloud breaches.

top_stories.title: Exploited SonicWall SSL-VPN flaw lets attackers bypass SAML-enforced MFA (CVE-2026-19868)
top_stories.summary: SonicWall has patched an actively exploited SSL-VPN vulnerability (CVE-2026-19868) in SonicOS that allows attackers with valid credentials to bypass SAML-enforced MFA. No workarounds are available, and SonicWall is urging administrators to apply the patch immediately.

top_stories.title: Railway breach leads to $740,000 in fraudulent AI charges
top_stories.summary: Railway, a cloud hosting provider, suffered a breach in which hackers exploited infrastructure vulnerabilities to steal customer authentication secrets. The attack resulted in approximately $740,000 in fraudulent AI charges and potentially exposed credentials for up to 100,000 workspaces.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Patches 1,259 Flaws, Including Exploited Outlook Bug That May Expose NTLMv2 Hashes
top_stories.summary: Microsoft released patches for 1,259 vulnerabilities across its software portfolio, including an actively exploited Outlook bug that may expose NTLMv2 hashes. The NTLMv2 hash exposure vulnerability is directly relevant to IAM professionals as NTLM credentials are used in Windows authentication flows and can be leveraged for credential theft and pass-the-hash attacks.

top_stories.title: Hackers Exploit Critical Xen Orchestra Auth Bypass Flaw to Gain Admin Access
top_stories.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability (VSA-2026-062) in Xen Orchestra, developed by French company Vates VMS, is being actively exploited in the wild. The flaw involves improper REST cookie parsing that converts an authentication token into an empty object, allowing attackers to gain admin access without valid credentials.

news.title: CISA flags Cisco BroadWorks flaw as actively exploited in attacks
news.summary: CISA has flagged a high-severity Cisco BroadWorks vulnerability as actively exploited in the wild. BroadWorks is a telecommunications platform, and authentication-related vulnerabilities in such systems are relevant to IAM professionals monitoring actively exploited credential or access flaws.

news.title: Obsidian expands AI agent security with runtime policy enforcement
news.summary: Obsidian Security has launched a Runtime Policy Decision Engine that gives security teams centralized control over AI agent actions before execution. The engine uses context from identity systems, third-party applications, and user-defined labels to allow, block, or require human approval for AI agent actions.

news.title: AI Coding Agents Leak Thousands of Secrets to GitHub
news.summary: A command in Claude Code inadvertently saves files containing credentials and other sensitive data to public GitHub repositories. This creates credential exposure risks for organizations using AI coding agents, as secrets intended to remain private are being leaked to public repositories.

news.title: SAP Patches Four CVSS 10.0 Flaws, Including Two Enabling Remote Code Execution
news.summary: SAP released patches for four maximum-severity CVSS 10.0 vulnerabilities on its monthly Security Patch Day, all exploitable without authentication. Three flaws affect SAP NetWeaver application server and one affects the Web Dispatcher, with two enabling remote code execution.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
news.summary: Microsoft released a Patch Tuesday update addressing nearly 1,100 security vulnerabilities across Windows and supported software, including 63 critical flaws. The update includes a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook, alongside security patches from Adobe, Apple, Google, and Mozilla.

news.title: Hackers Exploit Qubole's Trusted AWS Access to Breach Customer Accounts and Steal Data
news.summary: An attacker compromised AWS accounts belonging to multiple Qubole customers between October 14-26 by exploiting credentials from an AWS account used by Qubole's platform for customer access. The breach resulted in theft of stored secrets and data, highlighting risks associated with third-party trusted access patterns in cloud environments.

news.title: Default 'admin:admin' Server Password Helps Researchers Hack Two Automakers, Unlock and Start Cars
news.summary: Security researchers discovered that ForgeRock/Ping Identity servers used by two automakers' mobile apps had default "admin:admin" credentials left unchanged, enabling complete account takeover. The vulnerability allowed attackers to access any customer account and, for connected car owners, remotely unlock doors and start engines.

news.title: Web3Auth Flaw Exploited to Steal Keplr Crypto, Provider Empties Other Wallets for Safety
news.summary: A security flaw in Web3Auth, an authentication provider used by Keplr crypto wallet, was exploited by an attacker to steal funds from wallets linked via Google or Apple sign-in. Web3Auth subsequently used the same vulnerability to preemptively drain other at-risk wallets as a protective measure.

news.title: AWS STS now supports cross-partition federation for AWS identities
news.summary: AWS Security Token Service (STS) has added support for cross-partition federation, allowing workloads to use their IAM identity in one AWS partition to obtain temporary credentials for an IAM role in a different partition. This eliminates the need to store long-term credentials when operating across AWS partitions.

news.title: Attackers backdoor trusted AWS integrations to steal secrets
news.summary: Wiz researchers discovered a supply-chain attack in which threat actors backdoored trusted AWS integrations to steal secrets and credentials. The attack targeted AWS-connected software components, enabling attackers to exfiltrate sensitive identity and access credentials through compromised integrations.

news.title: Simplify cross-partition access with AWS IAM outbound identity federation
news.summary: AWS has expanded its IAM outbound identity federation to support cross-partition role assumption across Commercial, China, GovCloud (US), and European Sovereign partitions. This allows workloads to use IAM federation tokens to authenticate and authorize access across different AWS partition boundaries.

news.title: Week in review: Refrigeration cyberattacks hit European retailers again, Patch Tuesday forecast
news.summary: A weekly security news roundup includes a brief mention of AI coding agent identity and command policy. The IAM-relevant content appears to be a small portion of a broader cybersecurity news digest, focused on an interview about setting identity policies for AI coding agents.

news.title: Phishing-Resistant Isn't Enough; Yubico Takes Aim at Identity-Verification Gap
news.summary: Yubico launched YubiID, a new service that bridges identity verification with credential enrollment and recovery across existing identity platforms. The announcement also includes a post-quantum YubiKey beta, addressing authentication gaps beyond phishing-resistant MFA.
